meaning: Воин духа, высшая справедливость, верность долгу и победа

direct.description:
God, justice, sacrifice

Masculine rune, symbolizing a warrior, knight, activity. You are like a shot arrow, a purposeful fiery force lurks inside. Act without hesitation; now is the best time for achievements! Doing what you consider necessary and what you really want is favorable.

Tiwaz endows with honesty, openness, implementation and directness. Feel your fighting spirit rise! It's a symbol of love and service but it's very important that the effort put in is appreciated.
direct.advice: All doors are open to you. Share your power with those who need it. This kind of generosity will return to you tripled.

reversed.description:
Crisis, lack of energy

If the efforts put in turn out to be pointless, in response, there is no admiration, love and gratitude. That's when Tiwaz reverses. The rune requires transparency and honesty; otherwise, it's possible to fall under an illusion, blocking the accumulation of resources and strength. There is a threat of conflicts, quarrels with colleagues and relatives and the onset of a creative crisis.
reversed.advice: It's worth considering the current circumstances as an opportunity to view whether your life path is right. Accept the situation and look at it from the positive side: you have been given time to calmly deal with what is happening in the depths of your soul.

meaning: Сбор плодов, щедрый урожай, естественный цикл времени

direct.description:
Gradual progress

Jera rune symbolizes cyclicity, the sequence of natural processes. It suggests slowing down, looking around and synchronizing with the sensations. Now you are reaping what you have sown, so it’s crucial to understand whether the current plans will bring you what you want.

This rune brings about slow but steady changes that may only happen with patience and regular action. For all the hard work during the previous cycles, Jera rewards on a material and spiritual level.

Rune Jera helps to direct the way of life and reminds you that you attract to yourself what you believe in. The world is favorable to you and helps in the realization of dreams.

Jera calls you to be where you want to be, where you need to be — this is the key moment for materialization.
direct.advice:
Try to act consistently and take your time with things. Remember that there is a time for everything.

Develop a positive outlook. Put the meanings you want to fill your life with in every action.
Use affirmations.

reversed.short: Jera rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.description: Jera rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.advice: Сделайте шаг назад и восстановите внутреннее равновесие.

meaning: Факел вдохновения, прозрение, творческий огонь, исцеление

direct.description:
Flame, knowledge

Kenaz represents the principle of clarification and illumination. Symbolizes the fire that can heal the physical body, illuminate the true path and burn away ignorance.

Rune Kenaz helps to break out of the usual way of life, find the energy for change, start something new and create or strengthen relationships. It also activates curiosity and creativity, pushing for exploration and gaining new knowledge.

You may experience uncertainty in some matters and Kenaz rune has come to clarify and give the necessary knowledge. With the energy of Kenaz, you can reach the peak of your abilities, experience vivid sensations, burn with passion and strengthen the will to overcome and explore.
direct.advice:
Channel your energy into creativity or mastering a new skill. Follow what inspires you!

Develop intuition. Practice trusting the flow of life.

reversed.description:
Sickness, loss

Reversed Kenaz means the loss or end of something significant, as well as internal limitation. Symbolizes hidden anger or shame, can mean physical weakness or illness.

When Kenaz reverses, there is a blockage of the fiery flow, a decrease in vital energy — this can occur during a fixation on an event associated with accusation or rejection in the past. You may experience irritation and a desire to avoid people and the body may react through rashes and redness appearing on the skin.

Letting go of attachments and realizing that in order to let in the new, you need to let go of the old will help to go through the stage of reversed Kenaz easier. With resistance, there is a high chance of aggravating what is happening and getting burned even more.
reversed.advice:
Take care of your physical, emotional and mental health.

Find the reason for your anxiety and use this energy charge in your favor. Get experience and knowledge from the current situation.

meaning: Высшая защита, связь с высшими силами, щит осознанности

direct.description:
Protection, connection with the Divine

Algiz contains the power of a great blessing and symbolizes protection. Higher powers make sure that your plans turn out well.

This rune manifests when a person is ready to establish a deep connection with the Universe. You can experience the state of a medium — connect with higher meanings and receive tips from spiritual guides.

Planet Earth gives blessings and is a home for all living beings. Rune Algiz reminds us about the importance of harmonious contact with the Earth and nature.

Algiz is also a powerful guide to deep practices and travel through the World Tree.
direct.advice:
Trust your intuition. Feel the unity of all life on Earth. Feel as part of the Divine plan.

Practices to connect with higher powers will allow you to activate the Higher Self and define the route of your soul.
Practicing to connect with your spiritual animal will allow you to feel your nature and greater security.

reversed.description:
Vulnerability

Reversed Algiz rune warns of hidden danger and calls to be vigilant and careful. You may feel disconnected from higher powers.

The feeling of insecurity causes internal imbalance, so it’s essential now to be attentive to your actions and words.
reversed.advice: Be attentive to your emotions and states. Give up self-deception. Reduce contact with people who provoke you and feed on your energy. If you often think about someone who has died, it's time to let go of regrets, leave the past behind and focus on the present moment of your life.

meaning: Радость бытия, светлая надежда, гармония с миром, триумф

direct.description:
Heart joy, integrity

Rune Wunjo serves as a symbol of inner harmony and the most sincere joy. It means the end of an unfavorable period and the onset of the stage of realizing the true will of the soul. You have enough energy and support from higher powers to achieve your goals and make your dreams come true.

Now your desires coincide with your capabilities. You are a magnet for good luck. Enjoy this ecstatic state — everything is as it should be, everything is in the best and purest way.

Wunjo is also considered a money rune. It teaches us to think abundantly. Expressing gratitude for what you have will allow you to increase capital.
direct.advice:
Manifest and celebrate your life energy. Share your joyful state and strengthen meaningful relationships.

Turn to mindfulness practices. Notice the interconnections of what is happening around you. Develop intuition.

Engage in rituals that will support you and return you to inner harmony when the energy of the runes changes.

reversed.description:
Crisis

Reversed Wunjo warns of unexpected obstacles on the way to what you want. Temporary failure can lead to pessimism and suffering.

You doubt yourself and others, experience internal conflicts, feel insecure and dissatisfied. Fear of losing support makes it difficult to assess the true reality objectively. Intense experiences can block natural qualities and emotions.

This is a temporary stage, after which you can gain valuable insights and an additional energy resource for realizing your potential. Reversed Wunjo rune calls for awareness and caution when making decisions.
reversed.advice:
What qualities do you need to remove obstacles? What can help their development?

Remember that suffering is also a choice. You can change your reaction to any event. Difficulties arise in order for us to learn and grow.

Carefully analyze what is happening and try to avoid sudden mood swings. Make decisions promptly so as not to linger in the energy of reversed Wunjo.

meaning: Пауза, кристальная тишина, концентрация перед новым этапом

direct.description:
Freezing, crystallizing

Isa symbolizes cold and powerful ice. Some processes in your life may slow down — this is a sign that it is time to focus on the tasks of the soul.

This period is like a pause between inhalation and exhalation. It’s an opportunity to move from one state to another. You can learn this lesson through resistance or trust the Universe and create something new.

Isa makes us stronger. This rune helps with learning and developing spiritual thinking. It calls for immersion in studying the crystals of consciousness that form our individuality.
direct.advice:
Strengthen the voice of the spirit within yourself with the help of available practices — meditation and shamanic initiation.

Look for ways to develop concentration, will and attention as these qualities are helpful both for realization in the material world and for the soul.

reversed.short: Isa rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.description: Isa rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.advice: Сделайте шаг назад и восстановите внутреннее равновесие.

meaning: Преодоление кризиса, терпение, поиск внутреннего стержня

direct.description:
Necessity

Nauthiz — the rune of fate, symbolizes need, patience and determination at the same time. You have a pressing task ahead of you. You may experience disappointment and resistance but only by overcoming obstacles, by developing your will, will you become closer to yourself.

Destiny is determined by our needs and requirements and what we need doesn't always coincide with what we want. Nauthiz calls for learning to distinguish real needs from false ones.

Nauthiz is a light in the darkness. The period of unraveling knots and tangles of the past, after which you can come to a more transparent perception of the present.
direct.advice:
Notice which commitments from the past are still draining your energy. What hinders your development? What attracts trouble? During the period of Nauthiz rune, discipline should be shown in order to repay debts, develop new qualities and reach a new level of implementation.

Do not give up! Keep looking for new solutions to old problems.

Trust the Universe as it will show you the way.

reversed.description:
Stagnation

Reversed Nauthiz rune warns against rushed decisions and spontaneous actions. Perhaps you have already chosen the wrong way to solve the problem and now need help to come to terms with the consequences in the form of restrictions.

Reversed Nauthiz may mean an unwillingness to admit one's mistakes and learn from the past. A sense of impasse and despair — this stage is given for external and internal changes, for rethinking one's strengths and adjusting the vector of movement.
reversed.advice: Now is the best time to change your life path. Manifest and strengthen the qualities of restraint and self-control. Refrain from making hasty decisions, consider all the circumstances and double-check options for the development of events. Integrate valuable experience.

meaning: Истинное «Я», самопознание, человечность, коллективный разум

direct.description:
Perfection, human

Mannaz is the rune of human consciousness, always looking for wisdom and insight, seeking to continue the evolutionary movement. It symbolizes intelligence and purpose.

Rune Mannaz means a combination of external and internal perfection when the idea corresponds to the execution and the response corresponds to the request.

This rune gives access to the informational field of the Earth, which is called the Akashic Records. You can go beyond your current ideas and aspirations and embark on a true spiritual journey.

Now is the best time to open all facets of your soul crystal — this will strengthen the connection and attune with the world. You already have everything for harmonious relations and mutually enriching cooperation.
direct.advice:
Use the energy of Mannaz to improve memory and mental abilities.

Direct your attention to your inner self. Use more responsive tools — for example, astrology, human design, gene keys and numerology.

reversed.description:
Internal conflict, alienation

Reversed rune Mannaz symbolizes an obstacle, internal conflict and an unstable emotional state. At the subconscious level, you don't want to notice anything unusual and events and move away from solving problems.

You can try on other people's roles and broadcast someone's ideas and beliefs. This choice can lead to alienation, as other people will not be able to see the real you and will feel deceived.

If reversed Mannaz appeared when answering a question about work, then you probably have better options available to you.
reversed.advice:
What is stopping you from moving on? How can you help yourself cope?

Pay attention to what is happening within you with the available practices. Resolve the internal conflict to continue your movement.

meaning: Живой поток, глубинная женская интуиция, доверие течению жизни

direct.description:
Secrets of water, intuition

Laguz — a harmonious rune, personifies the flow, the element of water and flexibility. Life is impossible without water; therefore, this rune underlies all manifestations and is present in everything surrounding us.

Laguz enhances intuition and allows you to connect with any external flow and recognize its qualities. This rune indicates the potential for the development of magical abilities. You can see clearly, hear clearly and feel clearly.
Everything is running its course and your task now is to feel yourself and trust the flow. Higher powers are on your side, the guardian angel protects you.
direct.advice:
Trust your inner voice and it will not let you down.

What do dreams tell you? Keep a dream diary and get clues from the Universe through your own interpretation.

reversed.description:
Obsession

Rune Laguz reverses when the channel of communication with intuition is blocked. This condition can feel like emotional exhaustion or a nervous breakdown.

Reversed Laguz symbolizes a water stream that has lost its direction. Now you should rely on something other than intuition. It's better to temporarily suspend the implementation of plans to avoid wrong decisions and a standstill.

Reversed Laguz is associated with being stuck in particular time layers. Perhaps you didn't let go of an event or a person in the past, so now you feel at a dead end and go through the loop of the same feelings and thoughts.
You can worry about unfulfilled desires and consider what is happening as a defeat. This is the time to stop, adjust the vector of movement and reconsider how to achieve the goal.
reversed.advice: Help yourself get through this stage with relaxation practices. You can hear the voice of pure intuition from a relaxed state and follow it again.

meaning: Сакральный символ

direct.description:
Sacred seed, process, space

Rune Inguz is a symbol of the manifested libido, the masculine principle. It represents pure potential, momentum and fertility. You have enough concentrated energy to achieve your goals and bring them to their logical conclusion.

The rune helps to get out of a relaxed and dispersed state. It manifests itself through creativity, energy messages and living impulses. Dance, performance in front of an audience — will help express your main idea and give the necessary personal growth.

Inguz is also considered a rune of extrasensory perception. With its help, energy can be concentrated when focusing on a specific symbol or meaning. This opens up clairvoyance and clairvoyance in you and helps release the gift of prophecy.
direct.advice:
Meditate on the rune Inguz with a specific deep request. Concentrate it at the solar plexus level for social fulfillment or at the chest level to transfer energy to a partner and open up to them.

It's favorable to charge a seed with the intention and plant it in the soil. Your willpower will grow with it.

reversed.short: Inguz rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.description: Inguz rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.advice: Сделайте шаг назад и восстановите внутреннее равновесие.

meaning: Солнечная победа, ясность цели, триумф духа, исцеляющий свет

direct.description:
Sun, success, prosperity

The rune represents light, victory, luck, chance and opportunity. It bestows insight, awareness and a state close to genius. Sowilo is manifested when you clearly feel and foresee what exactly will be appropriate now, in the present moment.

You are seen as a courageous person who can react very quickly and adapt to new circumstances. You attract cash flow and admiring glances of others. You know how to be at the right time in the right place.

The general collective psychological space is open to your inner gaze.

Now you are like the Sun! Do not be afraid to act decisively, with complete confidence in your victory.
direct.advice:
Awaken natural optimism, show perseverance and dedication in any endeavors. It's very favorable to expand the area of your attention.

Be careful; excessive and vain use of the Sowilo rune entails psychological burnout and falling into your own psychological traps.

Practice meditations, Space of variations and Making decisions. The yogic practice of Surya Namaskar will help to harmonize the internal state.

reversed.short: Sowilo rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.description: Sowilo rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.advice: Сделайте шаг назад и восстановите внутреннее равновесие.

meaning: Изобилие, материальное процветание, созидательная энергия

direct.description:
Vitality, wealth

Fehu symbolizes wealth in a broader sense and teaches us how to manage it properly. One of the ancient meanings of this rune is livestock — what is owned and what needs to be handled correctly in order to benefit.

You are a beneficiary. Fehu gives the opportunity to discover spiritual potential, increase the financial flow and strengthen the resource qualities. This rune encourages action-taking and brings good luck to people striving for development and those who are always keeping busy.

Rune Fehu teaches conscious ownership of resources. It's important to understand what you actually own rather than to appropriate more. False ownership and hoarding can lead to a reversal of Fehu rune and loss of luck.
direct.advice:
Learn the lesson of mindful ownership. What is included in your ownership? Does it have room for what you desire? What needs to be given up?

Use Fehu's energy to deal with procrastination.

Define what wealth means to you. How can you expand your concept of wealth? What is truly valuable to you?

reversed.description:
Loss, liberation

Reversed rune Fehu warns of possible material losses, conflicts, violations of agreements, loss of respect or disagreements. It can symbolize ignorant use of wealth, for example, when a person studies and doesn’t use knowledge.

Reversed Fehu teaches us a simple truth: to let something new into your life, you must let go of something old.

The stage of reversed Fehu can be compared to purification, followed by an inspiring feeling of liberation. Having passed it, you can crystallize the dream of creation inside and invite what you want into the new, emptied space.
reversed.advice:
Sort out your online space, clean your house and eliminate the unnecessary. Terminate agreements you don’t need or change their terms.

If you have already made a decision, act and follow it through. If you are still in doubt, pay attention and be careful.

If you often incur material losses, analyze your ancestral connections for the possible forbiddance of having resources.

meaning: Рассвет, квантовый скачок, прорыв из тьмы к свету, новый день

direct.description:
Day, awakening

Rune Dagaz symbolizes transformation, light and the moment of transition to a new quality. It personifies the act of being born to the world at our highest potential and it happens at the right time because Dagaz is also about time. That is why it's so important to take your time with things.

This rune appears when a person is ready for a new experience and insight. It can be embodied in a work of art, an action, a person or a feeling. Dagaz teaches us to be in the process of constant renewal and transformation.

The rune teaches us not to be afraid of the unknown and says that darkness is always followed by light. Darkness is limited. It’s crucial to let go of heavy thoughts and trust the flow.
direct.advice:
Feel in the depths of yourself the birth of a new, the true. Imagine that you are a phoenix rising from the ashes. Let your power awaken!

Be bolder; if something interferes with your development, don’t hesitate to change circumstances.

Maintain your emotional state through meditation, affirmations and the flow of creativity.

reversed.short: Dagaz rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.description: Dagaz rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.advice: Сделайте шаг назад и восстановите внутреннее равновесие.

meaning: Родовое наследие, священный дом, духовные корни, опора

direct.description:
Kin, heritage, egregor

Rune Othala symbolizes the family inheritance, the family tree. This is the rune of people who refrain from illusions, have found their calling and carry along the ancestral force — through continuity and tradition or creating something new.

The rune allows moving purposefully, clearly, directing all the resources and potential to solve a more significant request.

Othala helps to define and prioritize, accept responsibility and legacy. It gives strength to solve a great kin problem through its unique experience, incarnation and place in the family. There is an opportunity to accept the family's power and resources and eliminate unviable patterns.
direct.advice:
It's favorable to engage in the practice of family constellations and meditation on uniting with the family.

Follow the traditions and create your own; this will help harmonize the rune and solve big problems. Accept the heritage of your kind to boost your own strength.

reversed.description:
Rush, wrongly chosen path

Reversed Othala speaks of an excess of responsibility beyond one's capabilities. It warns of the possible collapse of the undertaking. It may manifest as the desire to get out of the commitments and communication with loved ones, leading to a childish position.

In cases where responsibility had to be taken unwillingly because of pressure from others, a feeling of helplessness arises.
reversed.advice:
You must carefully consider your actions, consider the consequences and make informed decisions. Othala teaches us not to get hung up on the material world and to remember spirituality and family values.

The best thing to do now is to slow down and develop flexibility. Sometimes the best action is inaction, believing and accepting that everything is done for the good.

meaning: Дар, гармоничный союз, баланс принятия и отдачи, партнерство

direct.description:
Gift, partnership

Rune Gebo symbolizes the endless intersection of laws and paths. New opportunities open up before you, there is a clarification of consciousness. This rune can be perceived as a blessing or a call for liberation.

Rune Gebo teaches to create open programs and new formats of relationships where there is freedom and an agreement on responsibility. Gebo repels any form of addiction.

You follow the law of your true calling, so you have enough motivation to act. You are a human of the world. Gebo reminds us that there isn't just one truth and there are many intriguing points of view.
direct.advice:
Review existing agreements and be careful with future ones. Discuss mutually beneficial terms to keep the interest of all involved.

Accept your internal contradictions and connect the shadow and manifested parts — this will help to achieve harmony.

reversed.short: Gebo rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.description: Gebo rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.advice: Сделайте шаг назад и восстановите внутреннее равновесие.

meaning: Первозданная жизненная сила, преодоление препятствий, здоровье

direct.description:
Natural force, manifestation

Rune Uruz holds shamanic natural grounding power. It symbolizes the power of materialization and sexual energy. Uruz personifies health and is a metaphor for a place of power.

This rune can destroy everything old and obsolete that is preventing further growth and development. Uruz pushes out of the comfort zone, leading a person to revision and cleansing and encourages the creation of new scenarios and the acquisition of new qualities.

Uruz reminds a person of their ability to heal themselves on their own and to awaken their original natural state.

Uruz is a force that leads to a long-awaited transformation. This rune can be a powerful gift when used consciously, with the mind's control and within the framework. This impulsive and chaotic force can go beyond social norms and be rejected if used ignorantly. If you resist change, Uruz rune can take a reversed position.
direct.advice:
Pay attention to maintaining mental and physical health. Learn to manage your energy with the help of available practices — for example, qigong, breath work and psychotherapy.

Let go of the fear of the unknown and trust in the power of nature that leads to unleashing potential and more fulfilling life.

Learn to express your emotions correctly, especially when it comes to aggression. An emotions diary can help you manage your feelings.

reversed.short: Loss of strength, drain of energy
reversed.description:
Loss of strength, drain of energy

Reversed rune Uruz means a deterioration in health, a drain of energy and a weakening of the will. You may experience failure, lack of opportunities, frustration and powerlessness.

With its appearance, reversed Uruz reminds us that all the answers are already inside. You know what will help you get through this stage and get your life back on track. How quickly you integrate the experience and continue moving is up to you.
reversed.advice:
Look for a way out of this situation. Expand your perceptions. Strengthen the motivation for development.

If you are worried about FOMO (fear of missing out), find suitable ways to deal with it. For example, psychotherapy or keeping a gratitude diary.

Take care of your mental and physical health.

meaning: Стремительный прогресс, верное соратничество, шаг вперед

direct.short: Horse, trust, change for the better
direct.description:
Horse, trust, change for the better

The rune symbolizes the union of masculine and feminine, balance, merging in a single stream and progress. This rune is directly related to human consciousness. Inner harmony leads to maximum efficiency.

Ehwaz patronizes those who unite with each other to achieve a common goal. It helps speed things up, so moving in that direction will heal and align your whole natural state through fullness.

You have enough strength to carry out a great plan. A clear and powerful current takes you in the most favorable direction. Soon in your life, the moment you have been waiting for will come and the situation will begin to be resolved for the best.
direct.advice:
Pay attention to your desires, check if all your needs are covered. Get out of the position of the victim.

It's good to remember that only by changing ourselves, our attitude towards people and ourselves can we influence our destiny.

reversed.description:
Dissatisfaction, weakness, helplessness

All obstacles exist only in your mind and internal fears generate them. Out of nowhere, you may face circumstances that you did not expect.

The path is open but you may feel that you don't need to act right now. There is a danger of missing out on luck and your fortunate chance.
reversed.advice:
Do not be afraid of the flow that carries you, trust it — everything will be fine. Let new things come into your life.

Be patient, don't waste your energy and don't take risks. Take time to pull yourself together and gain strength.

Stabilize your emotional state through meditation and yogic practices. Help yourself get in the right mindset through a spiritual retreat or a trip away.

meaning: Сакральный символ

direct.description:
Journey, synchronization

Rune Raido symbolizes the road, the path, the journey, as well as movement. The energy of this rune activates the inner compass, you can understand better where the soul is calling you. Raido helps with finding oneself and setting goals and encourages spiritual development.

Raido is manifested when you have the necessary knowledge, energy and inspiration. Most importantly, when you are moving towards development according to the law of your true calling. In this state, you find yourself in the right place at the right time, surrounded by people on the same wavelength as you.

Rune Raido is called the amulet of travelers. It helps to avoid obstacles and rationally evaluate the situation on the road. It also helps journalists and opinion leaders share experiences and convey information.

If you are in an environment that is not facilitative to moving forward, the Raido rune will take on a reversed meaning.
direct.advice:
You dance a synchronized dance with the Universe and are filled with good luck. Don't stop, keep moving!

Use Raido's energy to negotiate with colleagues and resolve issues with loved ones.

Connect with those who inspire you. The energy of Raido indicates with whom you are sharing the same path and with whom the paths have already parted.

reversed.description:
Crisis, out of sync

Reversed Raido means a stop, a failure, a delusion or an accident. Something suddenly knocked you out of your usual rhythm and slowed your movement.

You may be distressed by ruined plans and angry at external events. There may be misunderstandings with colleagues and loved ones, leading to tension and affecting other areas of life.

Reversed Raido warns of the impossibility of achieving the goal and calls to accept what is happening and adjust the movement vector.
reversed.advice:
Analyze recent events and learn from them.

Let go of the connection with those who hinder your development.

Pay attention inward and balance your emotional state, for example, with the help of meditation, sound healing and psychotherapy.

meaning: Рождение нового, материнская забота, бережный рост, весна

direct.description:
Birch goddess, birth

This rune represents the feminine. The symbol of the nurse, mother, birch, all that feminine that has a healing natural magnetism. Berkano calls to follow the principle of growth and transformation; it can accelerate the course of events.

This is the rune of healers. Berkano comes to life as a stage of rebirth and fullness. Healing can take the form of restoration or cleansing. It's important not to resist the process but to trust it.

The rune helps to maintain peace, harmony and mutual understanding in the family. If there is yet to be a union, now is the best time to create one. By opening to the flow, you call into your life the motherly love of the Earth.
direct.advice:
Berkano warns that the circumstances are the most prosperous. Whether to use them is up to you. In the case of choosing not to do so, there will be no negative consequences.

Be sure to share the accumulated resources with others, give warmth and care to those who come to you. Berkano generously rewards this.

It's favorable to use the meditations Loving kindness and Feminine nature.

reversed.description:
Anxiety, trouble

Most often expressed by exhaustion, burnout and doubts. The rune can warn of disturbing news. Quarrels and conflicts among close people are possible.

Pay attention to the house and the family — is it as comfortable, relaxed and friendly as it was before? If not, you have the time and opportunity to improve things.
reversed.advice:
Try not to get annoyed, stop and listen to the rhythm of your heart. You will need to go back and sort out important matters you want to forget about, so it's better to prepare for them in advance.

Give yourself a break, rest and stop for a bit if you feel you need it. Think about everything you say, keep neutrality.

Use affirmations to maintain your emotional state.

meaning: Божественное озарение, мудрость слова, интуитивное знание

direct.description:
Voice of the Universe, inspiration

Ansuz is the rune of sacred knowledge and order. It's responsible for receiving or transmitting information.

The power of Ansuz lies in sounds and words. It encourages us to call things by their names and helps to build deep awareness.

Rune Ansuz means that you have learned an important lesson. It gives a blessing for learning and invites people into your circle to exchange information. It carries the energy of inspiration and enthusiasm.

Ansuz encourages the revelation of potential and symbolizes apprenticeship and teaching. If you pick up knowledge from your surroundings, then you need to appropriate it and integrate it into your ownership. Only after integration and living through the experience can you become a guide and transfer knowledge further.
direct.advice:
Develop the skill of recognizing the signs around you — this will help strengthen contact with the unconscious and receive clues from the Universe.

Pay attention to your speech and the words you use. Try to formulate and voice your thoughts more often.

reversed.description:
Delusion, unlearned lesson

Reversed Ansuz rune signals that you have not learned a lesson or have not used the information received earlier. You may find yourself in a state of the eternal student, walking in circles and experiencing resistance, even a lack of understanding of what is happening.

Perhaps you were given the wrong advice or you acted thoughtlessly. Your soul asks for greater honesty and sincerity, not only for others but also for yourself. Reversed Ansuz calls to reconsider your point of view and try to act differently.
reversed.advice:
If you notice a repeating scenario, the energy of Ansuz will help to work out that lesson — analyze past experiences, draw conclusions and behave differently.

Beware of others' advice! Make decisions based on your experience and feelings.

meaning: Тайна судьбы, глубинное возрождение, открытие сокрытого

direct.description:
Unknown, fate, game

Rune Perthro personifies the alchemical cauldron of initiation, the womb, the lair, the bag of runes and the secret. Learning the very essence is only possible after going through all the necessary stages, manifested by purification, rebirth, change and transformation.

A magical path is open before you. As you go through the process of initiation and a new identity, you will find a treasure that has been hidden until now. It can manifest within you; it can be given to you by the world. It's important to follow it consistently without rushing things and not looking for any shortcuts.

Perthro points to treasures and helps to gain insight. The rune guides us through the fantastic creation process — from conception to implementation. You are filled with a mystical consciousness, which is essential to comprehend the very nature of this process.
direct.advice:
A period of change has come in life. Be mindful as clues appear around you, telling you exactly what you need to let go of in order to move on. Accept calmly that your perception is changing dramatically.

Now it's favorable not just to create things or participate in processes but to put meaning and your soul into them. Perthro teaches you to concentrate as much as possible and approach everything consciously.

reversed.description:
Failure, ruined plans

Rune Perthro takes a reversed position when desirable is being achieved via any means. It's easy to lose good fortune and blessings in such a state.

Reversed rune warns of the possibility of having the result you were not hoping for. There may be a state of misunderstanding and rejection of the changes that have begun to occur. It might feel like something is being taken away against your wishes, that you are not ready to give up that something.
reversed.advice:
The reason for such destructive changes in life, for the time being, may remain a mystery. However, everything that happens is a consequence of one's wrong stereotypes and a wrongly chosen life path.

Remember to pay attention to the true needs of your soul. Now is the most favorable time for radical changes in yourself and your life. Agree to these changes so they can run their course as smoothly and painlessly as possible.

meaning: Мировое древо, несокрушимость, связь времен, духовная стойкость

direct.description:
Transition, path of the heart

Eihwaz personifies the key that opens the doors to all the worlds. It lets us into the space of archetypal streams, connects with the symbol of the macrocosm and microcosm — Yggdrasil tree. The gates to the path of the heart are open to you and the materialization of true desires is available.

The energy of Eihwaz rune is associated with witch power. A witch is one that never betrays herself and follows the call of her soul.

Eihwaz contributes to the transformation of the old identity and the birth of a new one. Leads to meaningful and desirable change.

Rune Eihwaz teaches us to take every step out of love, out of deep interest, with the thirst for knowledge, craving for insight and life-creation. Eihwaz is referred to as diverting forces, which steer you away from what is not to your liking and not good for your heart.

If an obstacle appears in your way, it will not interfere with a successful outcome but on the contrary, be beneficial — it will help you integrate the ongoing events.
direct.advice:
Practice Loving kindness Meditation.

Trust your intuition. Be aware of every decision and reaction.

Let go of everything that is now leaving your life with gratitude. Fill the process of letting go with creativity and engage in suitable rituals.

reversed.short: Eihwaz rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.description: Eihwaz rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.advice: Сделайте шаг назад и восстановите внутреннее равновесие.

meaning: Врата осознания, защита, расчистка пути, воля

direct.description:
Manifestation, protection

Rune Thurisaz is a symbol of the hammer, with which the god Thor created lightning and protected the gods and people from giants and monsters. This rune manifests itself when a choice appears: to use new opportunities and grow or leave everything as it was.

Now the energy has come for materialization. You are ready! After rethinking past experiences, the most powerful energy of Thurisaz helps to move from one level of consciousness to another. The transition process can be difficult or easy, depending on how much attention you pay to your soul and inner self.

Thurisaz indicates that the time has come to do the difficult inner work, shed light on your shadow parts and change.
direct.advice:
You may be in a critical situation that requires you to make quick decisions and take action. Keep moving with enthusiasm!

Use the energy of Thurisaz for protection and to guard yourself against unnecessary information and unfamiliar influences.

It may be that limiting attitudes and low-frequency emotions have more power now than the potential for success.

reversed.description:
Unreadiness

Reversed rune Thurisaz symbolizes the process of accumulating a resource before a decisive action. Now is the time to prepare for what will be manifested later.

Perhaps you still need to gather all the details and time to draw up a plan. You may need more energy to materialize your goals. Or you have to deal with the consequences of past decisions. Circumstances may be different, but in any case, higher powers are on your side.
reversed.advice: Give yourself time to draw up a plan and make a decision. Take your time to avoid mistakes.

meaning: Очищающая буря, освобождение от иллюзий, трансформация

direct.description:
Radical change, transformation

Hagalaz symbolizes what is out of our control, unexpected and sudden. Ahead is the time of testing, shifting to a new quality, to a different energy level through transformation.

Hagalaz leads to psychological birth — rupture of the umbilical cord, separation from parental figures, a change in worldview, greater self-sufficiency and a sense of maturity.

This rune removes energy stagnation, often manifested through apathetic states and diseases. It gives a chance to build a life in a new way. Helps turn adversity into opportunity and destruction into creation.
direct.advice:
Feel the call to change yourself within. Find the strength to endure the feeling of the unknown — it won't be like before. Trust change and try not to resist. Take risks and learn to act in a new way.

The intensity of events and experiences will be higher if you do nothing. Go towards the change!

Look for a connection with your personality through practices that support your emotional state: meditations, affirmations and prayers.

reversed.short: Hagalaz rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.description: Hagalaz rune does not have a reversed meaning.
reversed.advice: Сделайте шаг назад и восстановите внутреннее равновесие.
